text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Insolvency (Winding Up) (Fees) Rules. Fees
The fees specified in the Schedule shall be paid in respect of the matters to which they relate. (rule 2) FEES

On issuing an office copy of a judgment or order made in Court (except an order on a petition for winding up, an order adjourning a public examination, and an order appointing a shorthand

(a) if made in Court $25

(b) if not made in Court $15
Every order adjourning a public examination $5
Every order appointing a shorthand writer $5
Every affidavit filed other than proof of debt $10

For taking an affidavit or an affirmation in lieu of an affidavit, or $10 declaration, except for proof of debts, for each person making the same In addition thereto, for each exhibit referred to therein and required $5
On every proof of debt above $10 (other than proof for workmen’s $5 wages)
Every other office copy, for each page or part thereof $2
On every application to the Court to approve a reconstruction or $100 other scheme by which the affairs of the company are to be wound up otherwise than by the realisation and distribution of

On every order of the Court approving such reconstruction or scheme, a fee according to the following scale on the estimated value of the company’s property transferred or otherwise

(a) on the first $500,000 or fraction thereof ½%

(b) on the next $500,000 or fraction thereof ¼%

(c) above $1,000,000 or fraction thereof ⅛%
For taxation of costs — the same fees as those directed to be paid and collected by the order for the time being in force as to fees in the original jurisdiction of the High Court.
